title: 比较、同等程度与足够程度

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

questions.prompt: Light A is six watts; B is ten. A has ____ power than B.
options: fewer
less
many
more less
questions.evidence: 比较两个对象时，短形容词通常用 -er，较长形容词常用 more；less 修饰不可数名词，fewer 修饰复数可数名词。不要把 more 与 -er 重复使用。
questions.explanation: power 此处不可数，六小于十，用 less；fewer 修饰可数复数，more less 重复。

options: The first light is cheaper than the second.
The first light is more cheaper than the second.
The first light is cheapest than the second.
The first light is cheaping than the second.
answers: The first light is cheaper than the second.
questions.evidence: 比较两个对象时，短形容词通常用 -er，较长形容词常用 more；less 修饰不可数名词，fewer 修饰复数可数名词。不要把 more 与 -er 重复使用。
questions.explanation: cheap 的比较级是 cheaper；不能叠加 more，最高级 cheapest 不用于此处两者比较。

questions.prompt: In careful formal writing: The new plan uses ____ chairs than the old plan.
options: less
much
fewerer
fewer
questions.evidence: 比较两个对象时，短形容词通常用 -er，较长形容词常用 more；less 修饰不可数名词，fewer 修饰复数可数名词。不要把 more 与 -er 重复使用。
questions.explanation: chairs 是可数复数，正式书写中用 fewer；less 在非正式用法中也可能出现，fewerer 不是词形。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct comparative for efficient.
options: Light A is efficienter than Light B.
Light A is more efficienter than Light B.
Light A is more efficient than Light B.
Light A is most efficient than Light B.
answers: Light A is more efficient than Light B.
questions.evidence: 比较两个对象时，短形容词通常用 -er，较长形容词常用 more；less 修饰不可数名词，fewer 修饰复数可数名词。不要把 more 与 -er 重复使用。
questions.explanation: 较长形容词 efficient 常用 more efficient；不能再加 -er，most 为最高级。

questions.prompt: Both rooms are equally warm. Room A is ____ warm as Room B.
options: more
as
warmer
most
questions.evidence: as + 形容词原级 + as 表示程度相同；not as + 形容词原级 + as 表示前者在该方面不及后者。as 之间不用比较级。
questions.explanation: 程度相同用 as warm as；warm 保持原级，比较级或最高级不能放入该结构。

questions.prompt: Room A is less bright than Room B. Choose the matching sentence.
options: Room A is as bright as Room B.
Room A is brighter than Room B.
Room A is not as bright as Room B.
Room A is not as brighter as Room B.
answers: Room A is not as bright as Room B.
questions.evidence: as + 形容词原级 + as 表示程度相同；not as + 形容词原级 + as 表示前者在该方面不及后者。as 之间不用比较级。
questions.explanation: not as bright as 表示 A 不如 B 亮；相同程度、反向比较和 brighter 放在 as 中都不符。

questions.prompt: The batteries are equally large. The first is as ____ as the second.
options: larger
largest
more large
large
questions.evidence: as + 形容词原级 + as 表示程度相同；not as + 形容词原级 + as 表示前者在该方面不及后者。as 之间不用比较级。
questions.explanation: as 和 as 之间用原级 large；larger、largest 或 more large 不能填入此结构。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence meaning the two tables have the same height.
options: One table is as high as the other.
One table is not as high as the other.
One table is higher than the other.
One table is as higher as the other.
answers: One table is as high as the other.
questions.evidence: as + 形容词原级 + as 表示程度相同；not as + 形容词原级 + as 表示前者在该方面不及后者。as 之间不用比较级。
questions.explanation: as high as 表程度相同；not as 和 higher 表不同，as higher as 语法不合。

questions.prompt: The room is too dark to read. What does this mean?
options: It has enough light for reading.
It is brighter than every other room.
It was painted last year.
It is so dark that reading is not possible there.
answers: It is so dark that reading is not possible there.
questions.evidence: too + 形容词 + to do 表示程度过高而不能做某事；形容词 + enough + to do 表示程度足以做某事。enough 放在形容词之后。
questions.explanation: too dark to read 表黑暗程度使阅读不可能；enough light 的意义相反，其余不由该句推出。

questions.prompt: The shelf is ____ to reach without a chair.
options: enough low
low enough
too low enough
lower enough than
questions.evidence: too + 形容词 + to do 表示程度过高而不能做某事；形容词 + enough + to do 表示程度足以做某事。enough 放在形容词之后。
questions.explanation: enough 放在形容词 low 之后，low enough to reach 表足够低；其余词序或重复结构不合。

questions.prompt: The bag is very heavy, so Lee cannot carry it. Choose the matching sentence.
options: The bag is too heavy to carry.
The bag is heavy enough to carry.
The bag is too light to carry.
The bag is enough heavy to carry.
answers: The bag is too heavy to carry.
questions.evidence: too + 形容词 + to do 表示程度过高而不能做某事；形容词 + enough + to do 表示程度足以做某事。enough 放在形容词之后。
questions.explanation: too heavy to carry 表过重而无法携带；enough 表足够，词序错误或 light 都改变意思。

questions.prompt: The sign is easy to read from the door. Choose the matching sentence.
options: The sign is too unclear to read from the door.
The sign is enough clear to read from the door.
The sign is clear enough to read from the door.
The sign is too clear to read from the door.
answers: The sign is clear enough to read from the door.
questions.evidence: too + 形容词 + to do 表示程度过高而不能做某事；形容词 + enough + to do 表示程度足以做某事。enough 放在形容词之后。
questions.explanation: clear enough to read 表清楚到可以读；enough 应放在 clear 后，too unclear 表相反含义。

instructions: Read the Chinese explanations; the last four questions transfer the rule to new situations.
passage:
1. 比较两个对象时，短形容词通常用 -er，较长形容词常用 more；less 修饰不可数名词，fewer 修饰复数可数名词。不要把 more 与 -er 重复使用。
例句：A small lamp is cheaper than a large lamp. This appliance is more useful for the task.

2. as + 形容词原级 + as 表示程度相同；not as + 形容词原级 + as 表示前者在该方面不及后者。as 之间不用比较级。
例句：The two rooms are as bright as each other. This path is not as wide as that one.

3. too + 形容词 + to do 表示程度过高而不能做某事；形容词 + enough + to do 表示程度足以做某事。enough 放在形容词之后。
例句：The box is light enough to carry. The wall is too high to reach.
